description: Register a skill (Anthropic Agent Skills format: a SKILL.md file with YAML front matter + markdown body) once, referenced by name (skill_keys) from the MCP-aware agent components instead of repeating the same source fields inline in every one of them.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: mode='single' only. Dagster resource key other components reference via skill_keys.

name.label: Name
name.description: mode='single' only. Skill name override. If unset, read from the SKILL.md front matter at component load time.

description.label: Description
description.description: mode='single' only. Skill description override. If unset, read from the SKILL.md front matter at component load time.

git_url.label: Git Url
git_url.description: Git remote URL to fetch the skill(s) from (e.g. https://github.com/org/repo.git). Exactly one of git_url / local_path / url is required.

git_path.label: Git Path
git_path.description: Path within the git repo to the skill directory (mode='single') or the directory of skill subfolders (mode='collection'). Defaults to the repo root.

git_ref.label: Git Ref
git_ref.description: Git branch or tag to check out. An arbitrary commit SHA isn't guaranteed to work (depends on whether the remote allows fetching by SHA).

local_path.label: Local Path
local_path.description: Local filesystem directory containing SKILL.md (mode='single') or a directory of skill subfolders (mode='collection'). Exactly one of git_url / local_path / url is required.

git_token_env_var.label: Git Token Env Var
git_token_env_var.description: Env var holding a token for private-repo git auth (sent as an Authorization: Bearer header during clone).

url.label: Url
url.description: mode='single' only. URL to download the skill from -- either a raw SKILL.md file, or a .zip archive containing a skill folder (SKILL.md + any bundled files). Exactly one of git_url / local_path / url is required.

url_headers_env.label: Url Headers Env
url_headers_env.description: Env var holding a JSON object of HTTP headers to send with the download request (e.g. '{"Authorization": "Bearer ..."}'), for authenticated downloads.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: 'single': register one skill under resource_key. 'collection': treat git_path/local_path as a directory of MULTIPLE skill subfolders (e.g. a cloned anthropics/skills repo) and register one resource per subfolder, keyed by folder name.

include.label: Include
include.description: mode='collection' only: allow-list of subfolder names to register. Leave unset to register every subfolder that contains a SKILL.md.

exclude.label: Exclude
exclude.description: mode='collection' only: subfolder names to skip, applied after include.
